kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نمت (form I)
# نَمُتُّ (namuttu) /na.mut.tu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of مَتَّ (matta)
# نَمُتَّ (namutta) /na.mut.ta/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of مَتَّ (matta)
# نَمُتِّ (namutti) /na.mut.ti/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of مَتَّ (matta)
